plugins.contactsPermission: Hold only uses this to let you pick one person from Contacts at a time. It never requests access to your full address book.

plugins.microphonePermission: Hold uses your microphone only when you tap the dictation button, to turn your speech into text on this device.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Hold uses on-device speech recognition only when you tap the dictation button, to turn your speech into text.
